# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 1 token; Text — 3 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 2 tokens; Borders and rings — 1 token; Palette ramps and brand — 5 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 7 tokens; Radius — 4 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--surface, #f4f4f4);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--surface, #2b2b2b);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #f4f4f4;
```

### Tokens (1)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--surface` | #f4f4f4 | #2b2b2b | Sidebar, cards, caixas de código e inputs (Streamlit secondaryBackgroundColor). |

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--text, #111111);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--text, #ffffff);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #111111;
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--text` | #111111 | #ffffff | Texto principal sobre bg e surface (Streamlit textColor). |
| `--text-secondary` | #4a4a4a | #d4d4d4 | Subtítulos e a palavra CONSULTANT do logo. |
| `--text-muted` | #6b6b6b | #bdbdbd | Legendas, tagline, textos de ajuda. Passa 4,5:1 sobre bg e surface. |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--bg, #ffffff);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--bg, #111111);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #ffffff;
```

### Tokens (5)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--bg` | #ffffff | #111111 | Fundo da página (Streamlit backgroundColor). |
| `--brand` | #ffc72c | #ffc72c | Amarelo Pato: cor de marca. Fundo de botão primário, destaques, barra de progresso. Nunca como cor de texto sobre fundo claro (contraste 1,6:1). |
| `--brand-strong` | #d9a400 | #d9a400 | Amarelo Bico: hover do botão primário, bico e asa do pato, detalhes. |
| `--status-success` | #15803d | #4ade80 | Só para estado de UI: teste aprovado, veredito OK. Não é cor de marca. |
| `--status-error` | #b42318 | #f97066 | Só para estado de UI: teste falhou, bug detectado. Nunca na marca nem em decoração. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 800 40px/44px Inter, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.04em;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-display); letter-spacing: 0.04em;
font-family: var(--font-sans);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line, italic, letter spacing | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display` | `.display`, `--text-display` | 40px / 44px, letter-spacing 0.04em | 800 | `sans` | Nome da marca em caixa alta, capas e telas de abertura. |
| `h1` | `.h1`, `--text-h1` | 32px / 40px | 700 | `sans` | Título da página no app. |
| `h2` | `.h2`, `--text-h2` | 24px / 32px | 700 | `sans` | Títulos de seção (etapas do fluxo). |
| `h3` | `.h3`, `--text-h3` | 18px / 26px | 600 | `sans` | Títulos de card e de painel. |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 16px / 24px | 400 | `sans` | Texto corrido e User Stories. |
| `small` | `.small`, `--text-small` | 14px / 20px | 400 | `sans` | Legendas, ajuda e tagline. |
| `label` | `.label`, `--text-label` | 12px / 16px, letter-spacing 0.06em | 600 | `sans` | Rótulos em caixa alta: status, badges, cabeçalhos de tabela. |
| `code` | `.code`, `--text-code` | 14px / 20px | 400 | `mono` | Gherkin, Pytest e JSON do modelo de estados. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sans` | `--font-sans` | `Inter, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif` |
| `mono` | `--font-mono` | `"JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace` |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (7)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Entre ícone e texto. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Entre itens de um grupo pequeno, padding de badge. |
| `--space-3` | 12px | Padding vertical de botão e input. |
| `--space-4` | 16px | Padding de card, gap entre campos. |
| `--space-6` | 24px | Entre blocos dentro de uma seção. |
| `--space-8` | 32px | Entre seções da página. |
| `--space-12` | 48px | Topo da página e área de proteção do logo. |

## Radius

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--radius-sm: 6px) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--radius-sm), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (4)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--radius-sm` | 6px | Badges, inputs pequenos, blocos de código. |
| `--radius-md` | 10px | Botões, inputs, cards. |
| `--radius-lg` | 16px | Painéis grandes e modais. |
| `--radius-icon` | 22% | Cantos do ícone do app (112px em 512px). |
